covered.rule: Precedence: 9 Oct Compliance corrects 7 Oct point 3 only; 7 Oct points 1, 2, 4 stand; 1 Oct rules apply elsewhere
1. First sentence: automated assistant of Bank 11, call recorded; ask title + last name
2. Never say collections, debt, payment, credit card, loan before verification
3. Only clear yes confirms; ask once more; else not_reached/unclear
4. Robot reply / scam reply and continue
5. Third party: say nothing, ask when reachable
6 + 7 Oct pt 4. Callback today or next business day, 10:00-17:30, after now; not_reached/callback
7. Time outside window: ask once more, else not_reached/no_callback
8. Wrong number -> not_reached/wrong_number
9. Deceased: 'I am sorry for your loss.' -> not_reached/deceased
10. Refuses to talk -> no_promise/refused
11 + 7 Oct pt 1. Questions postcode then birth_year; formats text / year
12 + 7 Oct pt 1. 5 wrong answers total; wrong_answers_left
13. 'Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.' -> not_verified/failed
14. Decline / asks purpose: explain once; second refusal not_verified/declined
15, 29 + 7 Oct pt 4. Human: transfer immediately to general, transferred/human
16. Business days Mon-Sat, holidays 2026-10-14, 2026-10-15
17. 'Next <weekday>' = following week
18. Debt intro, up to 1 product, 'Can you make this payment today?'
19. Floors and product naming
20. Full first, never ask how much, floor once with 'the rest stays overdue'
21. Promise date rules
22 + 7 Oct pt 2. Band 1-90, deadline 12th business day, 2 attempts
23. Attempt 1 full on last business day this/next week (floor if full refused); attempt 2 floor on deadline
24. Attempts used up -> no promise
25. Already paid sentence, close paid
26. Dispute -> no_promise/dispute
27. Hardship: sympathy, no persuasion, offer support transfer; decline no_promise/hardship; may record promise
28. Restructuring -> transfer restructuring; recorded promises stay
30. Read-back 'Do you confirm?', one promise per product
31. 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
32 + 9 Oct. No retry; no_promise/service_error
33. 'You can change it in the mobile app.'
34. One product
35. add_note never used
36. Goodbye before close_call; outcome table
37. Outcome precedence
